notes: Unit cases for stripChromeTurns: the 700-character limit, each chrome condition, the header-line rules (90 characters, 12 lines), and the order of the two steps.

Only the two cases whose name starts with ORDER differ. Apple judges the raw first turn, so header residue condemns the whole turn. The web app strips header lines first. The second ORDER case shows the price: a page name that used to be dropped with its 'Sign in' line now survives as a short turn.
